name: nocompact
description: Instant, model-free context compaction for Claude Code: prunes old tool calls verbatim instead of summarizing, falls back to the built-in summary when that is not enough.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: jev: exactly what fast-jev-compaction did (every old tool call removed, text kept, built-in summary below the minimum reduction). smart: notes for removed calls, keeps questions and plans, truncates web and MCP output instead of removing it, and summarizes only the oldest part when pruning is not enough. Every setting below overrides the profile.

droppedCalls.title: Removed tool calls
droppedCalls.description: What happens to an old tool call no rule keeps. remove: call and output vanish (Jev). note: they vanish, leaving a one-line note naming the call. head: the call stays with its output cut to the first headChars characters. profile: use the profile's choice.

toolRules.title: Tool rules
toolRules.description: Per-tool overrides, first match wins, ahead of the profile's own: Tool=keep|remove|note|head, or Tool(subject)=action where subject matches the file path, command, URL or query. * and ? are wildcards. Example: AskUserQuestion=keep, Read(*.md)=keep, mcp__*mail*=head, Bash(git *)=note

keepRecentCalls.title: Recent tool calls to keep
keepRecentCalls.description: Keep this many of the newest old tool calls whole, beyond the preserved recent messages. Unset: the profile's (0).

headChars.title: Truncated output length
headChars.description: Characters of output a head-truncated tool call keeps. Unset: the profile's (jev 300, smart 500).

oldText.title: Old message text
oldText.description: keep: never touch text (Jev). abridge: shorten old assistant texts longer than abridgeAbove to their start and end on every compaction. abridge-all: the same for old user texts too. profile: use the profile's choice.

abridgeAbove.title: Abridge texts above
abridgeAbove.description: Characters above which an old text counts as long when abridging. Unset: 2000.

lowReduction.title: When pruning frees too little
lowReduction.description: summary: Claude Code's built-in summary of the whole conversation (Jev). abridge: first abridge long old assistant texts, oldest first; still too little, the built-in summary. hybrid: the built-in summarizer condenses only the oldest part and the newer part stays verbatim. profile: use the profile's choice. Errors always fall back to the built-in summary.

hybridKeepPercent.title: Hybrid verbatim share
hybridKeepPercent.description: For hybrid: the most the verbatim recent part may take, as a percentage of the conversation's original size. Unset: 40.

minReductionPercent.title: Minimum reduction (%)
minReductionPercent.description: Pruning must remove at least this percentage of the conversation's characters, or the low-reduction plan runs. Unset: 25 (Jev's).

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: The newest messages are never touched (nor is the first). Unset: 6 (Jev's).

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context %
compactAtPercent.description: After a turn, compact once the context window is this full; 0 leaves it to Claude Code's own auto-compact. Unset: 60 (Jev's).

thinking.title: Thinking in kept messages
thinking.description: drop: kept assistant messages and tool results are handed back as copies; they lose their thinking blocks, but a resumed session stays compacted. keep: they are handed back whole, thinking included, as fast-jev-compaction did; in Claude Code 2.1.318, resuming such a session brings the pruned history back and duplicates kept messages. profile: use the profile's choice (drop).

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: toast: a transcript line and a toast per compaction. log: the line only. off: silent. profile: use the profile's choice.
